title: Stylish 4BR Oasis w/ Hot Tub + City Views
description:
Experience Music City in style! 4BR/4BA retreat featuring a private rooftop hot tub with skyline views. Just minutes from Broadway, this modern home sleeps 12+ with 3 King suites and custom triple bunks. Perfect for groups seeking luxury and convenience.

The space
Experience Music City in style! This modern 4BR/4BA multi-level retreat features a private rooftop hot tub with sweeping Nashville skyline views. Located just minutes from Broadway, this home comfortably sleeps 12+ guests with 3 luxury King suites equipped with Sleep Number beds and a custom triple bunk room. Enjoy an open-concept living area, designer kitchen, and high-end finishes throughout. The ultimate luxury basecamp for groups, reunions, and Music City adventures!

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
